name: code_read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset (and other) emails build links from BASE_URL, which falls back to `http://localhost:3000` whenever the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable isn't set (`const BASE_URL = process.env.PUBLIC_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000";`). In production this variable is apparently missing or unset since last week's release, so every generated link points at localhost instead of the real deployed host. Fix by ensuring `PUBLIC_URL` is set in the production environment, and/or fail loudly at startup if it's missing instead of silently falling back to localhost.

input.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and passwordResetEmail (along with rollupText and scheduledExportEmail) builds its links from this constant. In production, PUBLIC_URL is apparently unset or not reaching the process, so the reset-password link, the weekly rollup link, and the scheduled export link all point at localhost instead of the public site.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set in the production environment/deployment config so it's always defined at runtime, and make the fallback fail loudly rather than silently defaulting to localhost — e.g. throw or log an error when PUBLIC_URL is missing in a non-development environment, instead of defaulting to "http://localhost:3000". This will prevent user-facing links (password reset, rollup, exports) from silently breaking when the environment variable isn't configured correctly after a deploy.
